title: "Root canal kitne ka hai?" Price bheja, *reply nahi aaya*.
message:
Root canal [₹ aapka rate] se shuru hota hai, tooth ke hisaab se.
Dr. [naam] *kal 11 am ya 5 pm* free hain. 10 min check-up free, phir exact price. Kaunsa time?
why: sirf price = comparison shopping. Price + *free next step + 2 time slot* = booking.
caption:
Patient ne WhatsApp pe price pucha. Aapne price bheja. Phir silence. 🦷

Kyunki sirf price milte hi patient 3 aur clinics se compare karta hai.

Fix: price ke saath 3 cheezein bhejo
1️⃣ Range ("se shuru"), exact nahi
2️⃣ Ek free next step (10 min check-up)
3️⃣ 2 time slot, taaki jawab sirf "5 pm" ho

Save karo 🔖 aur reception ko bhejo.

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
